title: Allah tries His servants
body:
Allah Almighty tries His servants to see if they are patient. We must remember this so that when an event
comes to test our patience we will remain firm. We must keep ‘patience at the first blow ’, we must keep our
faith, then our power will grow and the power of our enemies will decrease. Our real enemy is our own ego. In
the great war against our ego, ‘Jihad’, the angry man will lose and the patient man gains.
01.04.1999
